tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in every layout. The ground event imagery sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, table, inputs. One step above bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Modals, menus, popovers, toasts, hovered rows and the current nav item. In light it equals surface, so always pair it with a shadow token or border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table header, skeleton base, segmented-control track, Admin sidebar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only. Not enough contrast to mark a control: use border-control for that.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects, secondary buttons, checkboxes and the ticket perforation. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (venue, date, helper text) on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, captions, table column headers, on bg, surface and surface-raised. The lightest text that still holds 4.5:1; never go lighter.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Volt, the one vibrant color. Fill of the primary button, selected seat, selected chip, selected date, active tab indicator. Never use as text on light grounds: use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent controls.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed. Never white on Volt.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge on accent fills and the 2px active-tab indicator. Invisible in dark; in light it gives Volt the 3:1 boundary it lacks against white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text, links and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected rows, in-range dates and selected menu options. Text on it: ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset on every interactive element, so the ring is always drawn on the ground around the control, never on its fill. At least 3:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text and icon of success tone (Approved, Valid) on success-soft, surface and bg.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success badges and toasts.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text and icon of warning tone (Pending) on warning-soft, surface and bg.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning badges and toasts.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text and icon of danger tone (Rejected, Cancelled, field errors) on danger-soft, surface and bg. Also the border of an invalid input.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of danger badges and toasts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button only.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text and icon of info tone (Refunded) on info-soft, surface and bg.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of info badges and toasts.

tokens.name: neutral-text
tokens.usage: Text and icon of neutral tone (Draft, Used) on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral badges and default category chips.

tokens.name: seat-available
tokens.usage: Fill of an available seat on surface or bg. 3:1 against both.

tokens.name: seat-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected seat; carries a check in on-accent and an accent-edge border.

tokens.name: seat-held
tokens.usage: 2px ring and center dot of a seat held in someone's checkout. Never a solid fill, so it differs from available by shape.

tokens.name: seat-sold
tokens.usage: Fill of a sold seat. Deliberately low contrast: the seat is disabled; the cross inside is ink-subtle.

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: Text set over event imagery, always on top of image-scrim. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: image-scrim
tokens.usage: Dark end of the bottom-up gradient under text on imagery, and the ground of chips placed on images.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, bottom sheets and the mobile sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: The QR tile. White in both themes so scanners read it.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: QR modules and the ticket code printed on qr-ground.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on the Public home page from bp-lg up. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero headline below bp-lg; event title on the event page from bp-lg up.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in dashboards; event title on mobile.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Event card and ticket card title. Clamp to 2 lines.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Doors open at 19:00. Bring the QR code on your phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Двери открываются в 19:00. Покажите QR-код на входе.
styles.usage: Default text and every form control. Never set inputs below 16px: iOS zooms.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: 입장은 19:00부터입니다. 입구에서 QR 코드를 보여 주세요.
styles.usage: Card meta (date, venue), table cells, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, legends, footnotes. The smallest size in the system.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Button labels (md and lg), tab labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, small buttons, chips, nav items.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges and counters. Sentence case, never all caps: Hangul has no case and Cyrillic caps run wide.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The amount in a price tag. Tabular figures, never wraps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Ticket codes, order numbers, seat coordinates.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside compact controls; gap between a label and its field is space-2, between stacked meta lines space-1.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; card body padding on mobile; grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card body padding from bp-md; modal padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter from bp-md; grid gap from bp-md; modal padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dashboard main padding from bp-lg; gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter from bp-lg.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections from bp-md.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections from bp-lg; empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding from bp-lg.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Seats, checkboxes, calendar day cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav items, menu options, QR tile, table wrap on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Event cards, ticket cards, tables, popovers, stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets (top corners), hero imagery.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, avatars, icon-only buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hovered event card.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, date picker popover, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Minimum height of small buttons and chips. Desktop dashboards only; too small for touch.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Minimum height of default buttons, inputs, selects, tabs. Also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the checkout call to action and the hero search.

tokens.name: navbar-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the Public navbar and dashboard top bar from bp-md (56px below).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Organizer and Admin sidebar from bp-lg.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of the Public layout.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text (event description, legal pages).

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones. Event grid goes to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets. Navbar shows links; modals stop being bottom sheets; gutters grow to space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop. Dashboard sidebar becomes permanent; event grid 3 columns.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop. Event grid 4 columns; content stops growing at container-max.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky navbar, top bar, bottom nav, sticky checkout bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, select listbox, date picker popover.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, bottom sheets, sidebar drawer.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts. Above everything.
